summary: Community installations can connect to Invardia for health reports and updates, only if you choose to.

new.title: Optional connection to Invardia at install
new.text: The install asks once whether to connect to Invardia; the answer is no unless you say yes. Running the install again keeps a yes; the install's no option takes it back.

new.title: What a connected installation shares
new.text: Connected installations send health reports with numbers and states only, never users, devices, tag values or names. Invardia can then ask them to update now. No licence is needed.
